title: feat(grid): rich-content cells edit in a panel under the cell; related tab pinned
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XURgXCZHcjPoyo5g9cMEATi)_

Fixes #36023

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表里的富文本、Markdown、HTML 格子，选中后回车会在格子下面弹出编辑框，记录页子表页签里也一样；以前这些格子不能改，只提示去记录页改。
- 属于「列表页重做」专题，补上格内编辑重做卡里富文本那一项和子表页签那一项，做完这张卡就齐了。
- 出错的话最多是这三种格子的编辑框不好用，记录页和表单的编辑不受影响；整个改动可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The last slice of #36023 (S3, S4 and S5 landed as `Part of`): rich text opens an edit panel under the list cell, and the related tab is pinned to behave like the list.

- **Rich-content cells edit in a panel under the cell.** A `markdown`, `html` or `richtext` cell, on Enter / F2 / typing / double-click, opens the record form's own text box (`RichTextField`) over the stored source in the below-cell panel S4 built (`GridCellFacts.editor: 'below'`, `CellOverlay placement="below"`). The cell keeps drawing its value, the row keeps its height (the panel is a fixed-position popper), and the panel is at least the column's width (the overlay's anchor-width floor; the inner box asks for `min-w-80`, as `markdown` already did in `cellEditorWidthClass`).
- **Keys, per card item 4 and rulings D2 / D4:** Enter is a new line; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves and keeps the cell selected; Esc discards; a click outside saves. No `data-table.tsx` change was needed: its injected-editor wrapper already commits a TEXTAREA only on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter on the select-first grid, discards on Escape and commits on an outside pointer press. Measured by the tests below, not assumed.
- **The split (cell vs detail), not a widening of the shared set.** `markdown`, `html` and `richtext` stay in `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES`; `hasFieldEditWidget` and `isInlineExcludedFieldType` answer exactly as before, so the record page's field editor (`InlineFieldInput`, `fieldEnrichment`), the required-fields dialogs (grid, kanban, record path, save bar), `RequiredFieldsDialog` and the timesheet keep them out. `@object-ui/fields` adds `hasInCellPanelEditWidget(type)` (true for the three types, false for a retired spelling), and `FieldEditWidget` draws their editor only when the host passes `inCell`. In `plugin-grid`, `fieldInlineReadOnlyKind` exempts exactly what `hasInCellPanelEditWidget` names (the same carve-out shape as `plugin-detail`'s `DETAIL_ROUTED_INLINE_TYPES`), `PANEL_EDITOR_FIELD_TYPES` gains the three types, and `renderCellEditor` accepts either predicate.
- **One list, no second spelling (rework round 1).** The three types are now read from `RICH_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES` (`fields/src/widgets/richTextDisplay.tsx`, the keys of `RICH_TEXT_CELL_RENDERERS`) in all three places that named them by hand: `IN_CELL_PANEL_EDIT_WIDGETS` in `FieldEditWidget.tsx` is built from it, `PANEL_EDITOR_FIELD_TYPES` spreads it, and `cellEditorWidthClass` in `ObjectGrid.tsx` checks it before its switch. A type added to the display table gets its cell panel, its below placement and its width in the same commit. Derived rather than pinned only, because the cost is nil: `richTextDisplay.tsx` is already in the eager `ui-components` chunk through `getCellRenderer` (and `ObjectGrid.tsx` already imported the list), so the derivation adds one import of a module that is already loaded. A pin was added as well (see Tests).
- **Lazy.** The editor is `React.lazy(() => import('./widgets/RichTextField.js'))` inside `FieldEditWidget`, rendered in the same `Suspense` boundary the date pickers use (`LAZY_EDIT_WIDGETS`). Note: `RichTextField` is already in the eager `ui-components` chunk (it is statically re-exported by the barrel and already listed in `scripts/vite-ineffective-dynamic-imports.ts`), so the `import()` moves no module; the eager-closure reading is in Verification.
- **`html` is safe to edit as text.** What the cell then draws goes through `renderSanitizedHtml` (`rehype-sanitize` with `RICH_TEXT_SANITIZE_SCHEMA`, no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), the same pipeline every other read surface uses. So `html` is enabled with the other two.
- Multi-line text and address are untouched (ruling D3 A). No form or record-page editor face changes, and the save model and undo are unchanged.

## Tests

New pins:

- `fields` `inCellFaces-35688.test.tsx`, describe "in-cell rich-content panel": the three types answer `hasInCellPanelEditWidget` true while `hasFieldEditWidget` stays false and `isInlineExcludedFieldType` stays true; no other type (text, textarea, address, password, secret, object, file) is a panel; with `inCell` the widget is a TEXTAREA holding the stored source, typing stages, and Enter reaches the grid's wrapper with its default intact; without `inCell` the same field gets no editor.
- `plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`, describe "a rich-content cell edits in a panel under it": markdown, HTML and rich text each open `data-placement="below"` with the cell display still drawn and no read-only reason; Enter writes nothing and keeps the panel; Ctrl+Enter and Cmd+Enter each save one update and the cell stays selected; Esc writes nothing; an outside pointer press saves.
- `plugin-grid` `relatedTab.cellEditing-36023.test.tsx` (new file, the real chain `RelatedList` enlarged → `object-grid` → `data-table`): on the related tab a select opens its list under the cell with its value still drawn, Enter saves a text cell and the selection stays, and rich text opens its panel where Enter is a new line and Ctrl+Enter saves.

Rewritten tests (the card asks for the list):

- `plugin-grid/src/inline-edit-options.test.ts`: "keeps a markdown cell read-only — the detail row editor (objectui#11541) is not a grid one" is replaced by "edits the rich-content types in a cell, in a panel under it (objectstack#36023)", with a control that a `readonly` rich-text field stays `readonly` and that `password`, `secret`, `object`, `file` stay `notInline`.
- `plugin-grid/src/objectGridCellFacts-35684.test.ts`: the placement test now lists `markdown`, `html`, `richtext` among the types that open below, and a new pin "every rich-content type the display table serves edits in a panel under the cell" walks `RICH_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES` and asserts, for every entry, `hasInCellPanelEditWidget(t)` is true, `inlineEditorPlacement(t)` is `'below'` and `fieldInlineReadOnlyKind({ type: t })` is null (plus a non-empty guard on the list).
- No screenshot baseline is invalidated. `ObjectGrid.requiredPrompt-35956.test.tsx`'s "a field with no in-place editor (rich text) asks nothing" still holds unchanged: the required-fields prompt asks `hasFieldEditWidget`, which this PR does not move.

## Acceptance notes

**Browser readings (rework round 1), Chromium at 1280 x 900, showcase field zoo.** Stack: `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` for `examples/app-showcase` plus the console dev server, both from this branch's head `bc9b5c23`. The zoo's default list does not show the rich columns, so `f_markdown`, `f_html` and `f_richtext` were added to its `columns` for the run only (uncommitted, reverted with `git checkout HEAD --` afterwards; `git diff HEAD` empty). Row: "Specimen — Full". The panel was opened by selecting the cell and pressing Enter, and closed with Esc. Theme set through the console's own theme key; the root element's class read `light` / `dark` on each pass.

| Type | Theme | Row height before | Row height, panel open | Row after Esc | Cell (w x h) | Panel (w x h, at x,y) | Panel background |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| markdown | light | 45 | 45 | 45 | 167 x 45 | 330 x 188 at 828,207 | rgb(255, 255, 255) |
| html | light | 45 | 45 | 45 | 143 x 45 | 330 x 188 at 942,207 | rgb(255, 255, 255) |
| richtext | light | 45 | 45 | 45 | 143 x 45 | 330 x 188 at 942,207 | rgb(255, 255, 255) |
| markdown | dark | 45 | 45 | 45 | 167 x 45 | 330 x 188 at 828,207 | rgb(26, 26, 30) |
| html | dark | 45 | 45 | 45 | 143 x 45 | 330 x 188 at 942,207 | rgb(26, 26, 30) |
| richtext | dark | 45 | 45 | 45 | 143 x 45 | 330 x 188 at 942,207 | rgb(26, 26, 30) |

- The row height does not move when the panel opens, in either theme, for any of the three types; the panel starts 2 px under the cell's bottom edge (cell bottom 205, panel top 207) and is gone after Esc.
- The panel is wider than the column (330 against 167 / 143). For html and richtext, the two rightmost columns, it is shifted left to x 942 so its right edge (1272) stays inside the 1280 viewport.
- The textarea holds the stored source, read from its value: the seed's heading line and two list lines for markdown, and the raw markup (tags included, not rendered) for html and richtext.
- Dark-theme look at the open panel (markdown and richtext screenshots read): a dark panel with a violet focus ring, light monospace source text, the selected cell outlined in violet above it, and the row and the cell's drawn value unchanged behind it. No light-on-light or clipped edge. Screenshots were kept local and not committed.
- Out of scope, seen during the reading and NOT fixed here: the markdown cell draws the seed's `# Heading` at heading size, truncated to "Headin…", and that row is 45 px against 36 px for the row without rich values. That is the read-only display pipeline (`MarkdownCellRenderer`), which this PR does not touch, and it is the same with the panel closed. Reported to the seat in the os-dev report.
- The required-fields dialogs still do not offer a rich-text editor for a rich-text field (they ask `hasFieldEditWidget`); unchanged on purpose, out of this card's scope.

**Adjacent fix.** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md` cited `isFieldInlineEditable` as `src/inline-edit-options.ts:82`. This PR edits that file, so the line number would point at other code; the citation now reads `isFieldInlineEditable` in `src/inline-edit-options.ts`, with no line number, so it cannot drift again.
- Carried by #36360: seat 7's contract delta 7076344850 S2 (should-fix, non-blocking: the plugin-grid and fields READMEs and the plugin-grid docs page describe the panel and its keys without the select-first scope the changeset now has) and N1 (nit: the changeset's "Before" sentence and the `IN_CELL_PANEL_EDIT_WIDGETS` jsdoc). Text only; per the maintainer's 2026-11-22T07:49Z direction, small later changes go on their own card rather than another rework round.

## Verification

Two-minute check: open a list with a rich text column, click a rich text cell, press Enter. Expected: a text box opens under the cell with the stored source, the row does not grow, Enter adds a line, Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter) saves and the cell stays selected, Esc closes without saving.

Read first (by risk):

1. `ui/packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx`: `IN_CELL_PANEL_EDIT_WIDGETS`, `hasInCellPanelEditWidget` and the one-line `Widget` resolution in `FieldEditWidget` (the only path by which the three types can reach any host, gated on `inCell`).
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/inline-edit-options.ts`: the carve-out in `fieldInlineReadOnlyKind`, ordered after the binary/computed checks and before the shared exclusion.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridCellFacts.ts`: `PANEL_EDITOR_FIELD_TYPES`.

The local test, ablation, gate and eager-closure readings are posted with the os-dev report comments on #36023 (round 0 on `03473f46`; the rework delta on `bc9b5c23`, with the narrowed test run 5 files / 85 tests passed).
